snippet.title: Gramm - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gramm releases on Steam on October 20th, 2022 at a price of $2.99.
Run away from Gramm and his friends as you collect, escape, survive, fight, and parkour your way to victory. Don't ever get taken off guard, or you will pay the price.

This game includes:
15 levels
1 multiplayer level
8 different dogs
